name: starcil
title_zh: 在终端分屏里指挥 AI 特工舰队，不切窗口
tagline_zh: 写代码时 AI 卡在隔壁窗格？不用切走、不用复制粘贴，直接发指令、拆任务、并行跑，像指挥舰队一样把活分下去。
tagline_en: Stuck with an AI agent in a neighboring pane? No switching, no copy-paste—split, brief, and run agents in.
desc_en: Control Starcil, the terminal workspace for AI coding agents, from inside one of its panes (requires STARCIL_ENV=1). Use it to inspect neighboring panes and agents, split panes, run commands, read output and wait for state changes — and use it PROACTIVELY to work as a fleet: start peer agents (any installed CLI, same vendor or mixed) in sibling panes, hand them compiled briefs, run them in paralle
why_zh: 它把终端本身变成指挥台，让 Agent 之间能互相看见、互相调度，而不是各干各的。
why_en: Turns the terminal into a mission control where agents see and command each other, not just run in isolation.
limit_zh: 只在 Starcil 终端里生效，且需要 STARCIL_ENV=1；它调度的是同终端下的窗格。
limit_en: Only works inside Starcil with STARCIL_ENV=1; manages sibling panes only—no external processes or remote hosts.
title_en: Command an AI agent fleet from inside your terminal pane
